BEGIN

 INTO vNATID

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_SEC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure chk_sec(P_USER_NO VARCHAR2,blk_name in varchar2,P_FORM_NAME VARCHAR2) is
blk_id Block; 
blk_state varchar2(10);
begin
 blk_id:=Find_Block(blk_name); 
 blk_state:=Get_Block_Property(blk_id,INSERT_ALLOWED);
 if blk_state='TRUE' AND GET_U_PREV20(P_USER_NO,P_FORM_NAME,'I',null,:global.current_info_center_id)=0 THEN
 Set_Block_Property(blk_id,INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 blk_state:=Get_Block_Property(blk_id,UPDATE_ALLOWED);
 if blk_state='TRUE' AND GET_U_PREV20(P_USER_NO,P_FORM_NAME,'U',null,:global.current_info_center_id)=0 THEN
 Set_Block_Property(blk_id,UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 blk_state:=Get_Block_Property(blk_id,DELETE_ALLOWED);
 if blk_state='TRUE' AND GET_U_PREV20(P_USER_NO,P_FORM_NAME,'D',null,:global.current_info_center_id)=0 THEN
 Set_Block_Property(blk_id,DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 blk_state:=Get_Block_Property(blk_id,QUERY_ALLOWED);
 if blk_state='TRUE' AND GET_U_PREV20(P_USER_NO,P_FORM_NAME,'S',null,:global.current_info_center_id)=0 THEN
 Set_Block_Property(blk_id,QUERY_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: HIDE_AN_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Hide_an_Item( item_name VARCHAR2, hide_it BOOLEAN) IS 
 it_id Item; 
 BEGIN 
 it_id := Find_Item(item_name); 
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 null;
 --messag('No such item: '||item_name); 
 --RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 ELSE 
 IF hide_it THEN 
 Set_Item_Property(it_id,VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 ELSE 
 Set_Item_Property(it_id,VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 Set_Item_Property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 Set_Item_Property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MESSAG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE messag(str varchar) IS
 AL_ID ALERT;
 AL_BUT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 AL_ID:=FIND_ALERT('ERR_ALERT');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY(AL_ID,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,str);
 AL_BUT:=SHOW_ALERT(AL_ID);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_INTERFACE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*******************************************
 Code modified by the Forms Migration Assistant

 *******************************************/

procedure do_interface IS
 v_insert_done boolean default false;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
 procedure chg_prmpt(p_block varchar2,p_item_name varchar2) is
 v_found varchar2(30); 
 v_tmp varchar2(30);
 v_prompt varchar2(30);
 v_item varchar2(30);
 --v_insert_done boolean default false;
 
 begin
 if not (p_block is null) then
 v_item :=p_block ||'.'||p_item_name;
 else
 v_item :=p_item_name;
 end if;
 v_prompt:= get_Item_Property(v_item ,prompt_text);
 --message (v_prompt);
 select COUNT(*) 
 into v_found
 from trans
 where cntl=p_item_name ;
 if v_found=0 then
 insert into trans (cntl,str_a,str_e) values (p_item_name,v_prompt ,v_prompt);
 v_insert_done:=true;
 end if;
 if :global.lang='A' THEN
 select str_a into v_tmp from trans where cntl=p_item_name;
 else
 select str_e into v_tmp from trans where cntl=p_item_name;
 end if;
 Set_Item_Property(v_item,prompt_text,v_tmp);
 exception
 when others then
 NULL;
 end;
BEGIN
 if :global.lang='A' THEN
 set_form_property('nat',direction,RIGHT_TO_LEFT);
 set_window_property('window1',direction,RIGHT_TO_LEFT); 
 ELSE
 set_form_property('nat',direction,LEFT_TO_RIGHT);
 set_window_property('window1',direction,LEFT_TO_RIGHT); 
 END IF;
 -- chg_prmpt(NULL,'NATID');
 -- chg_prmpt(NULL,'NATDESC');
 
 if v_insert_done then
 COMMIT_FORM;
 end if;
END;
